title: ‘Unprecedented’ & ‘Egregious’ Free Speech Attack: Democratic FCC Commissioner on Trump, Kimmel, and Disney
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) in the US is once again going
after Disney and Jimmy Kimmel, after the late-night host jokingly called First
Lady [Melania Trump](https://zeteo.com/p/melania-epstein-trump-first-
draft?utm_source=publication-search) an "expectant widow" days ahead of the
[White House Correspondents' Dinner](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-white-house-
correspondents-dinner?utm_source=publication-search).

**Mehdi** spoke to the FCC's only Democratic Commissioner, **Anna Gomez,**
after the agency
[ordered](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-416A1.pdf) eight
Disney-owned TV stations to file early broadcast license renewals.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" This is unprecedented. It's unlawful,"** Gomez says. **" It's a political
stunt and it's bound to fail."**

Mehdi also pushed Gomez on whether the FCC is indeed acting independently, as
it is meant to do. **" We are clearly not behaving independently,"** says
Gomez. **" We seem to be doing the bidding of this White House."**
